Clothing & Decoration: Rich and well made, with elaborat collars. The High Men of the southern lands wear light tunic and often go without leggings. Those of colder areas wea more. They favor feathers and white symbols on dark fields Fears & Inabilities: The High Men fear Death, for they ar acutely aware of their own great skills and potential. Lifestyle: Well organized, comfortable, and centered aroun cosmopolitan cities and towns. High Men are traditional an well-educated—their early days are so filled with learning. Marriage Pattern: Monogamous. They often marry folk o other races. The line is traced through the male. Religion: Restrained and personal. The High Men revere th “True Gods.” They have elaborate burials involving preserva tion of the body.
